criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name $272M, RHTP, AI telehealth, and signal the correction without snark, within the 210-char cutoff. Withholds the specific nature of the bar (broadband) for one beat. Near 10.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: $272M active program, 403 projects advancing, late-June deadline, named sector, named stranded-asset risk, named decision actors (applicants, DOH). Both sides fully developed.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Para 3 gives the strongest honest version generously: deliberate tech-favoring design, mature AI/telehealth modalities, 403 projects, national-model potential. No snark. A believer feels fairly represented.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Three primary-source rebuttal points: Alaska DOH program page (broadband prohibition), HRSA Telehealth Broadband Project (6.6% / 27.1 Mbps), ADN verbatim Betsy Wood quote. All in claim_dossier.json.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Specifics nearly every sentence through the rebuttal: $272M, 165+ villages, 403 projects, 6.6%, 42 locations, 100/20 Mbps, 27.1 Mbps, Betsy Wood, BEAD, ReConnect, late-June. Slight dip in closing.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim: ADN primary, dated, verbatim. Counter-evidence predominantly primary (DOH page, HRSA data, ADN quote). One secondary item (GovTech) carries only a timing fact.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Matches post_001.md analytical, position-taking, structural cadence. Corrective not contemptuous. One minor colloquial moment ('So the more accurate frame looks like this').

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 433 words, 2794 chars, within spec. Paragraphs 2-4 sentences. One bullet block of 4 single-clause items. Scans cleanly.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closes with a binary, genuinely debatable policy question tied to the corrected frame. No CTA, no rhetorical softener.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: RHTP applicant, DOH PM, or BEAD allocator can name an immediate decision to reframe. Decision window, dollar risk, and alternative vehicles all named.

one_sentence_fix: Name 'broadband' explicitly in the first line so the load-bearing tension is concrete at the hook rather than revealed one beat later.
